name: Tipsy 1.2.0
body:
Note repo release may be delayed due to github action issues (thank you github actions!!! :heart: )

```md
## Install


```sh
# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://32bitx64bit.github.io/Tipsy-repo/keys/tipsy-signing-key.asc \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/tipsy.asc > /dev/null
echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/tipsy.asc] \
https://32bitx64bit.github.io/Tipsy-repo/apt stable main" \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/tipsy.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y tipsy
```

```sh
# Fedora / compatible
sudo curl -fsSL -o /etc/yum.repos.d/tipsy.repo \
  https://32bitx64bit.github.io/Tipsy-repo/rpm/tipsy.repo
sudo dnf install -y tipsy
```

```sh
# Flatpak
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tipsy \
  https://32bitx64bit.github.io/Tipsy-repo/flatpak/tipsy.flatpakrepo
flatpak install -y tipsy io.github.tipsy_linux.Tipsy
```

AppImage attached below as always. Updates arrive through your package
manager (`apt upgrade` / `dnf upgrade` / `flatpak update`); only AppImage
updates itself in-app. Roblox itself is never included — use the in-app
setup assistant.

## Highlights
- **Native Linux distribution**: official APT and DNF repositories, Flatpak
  repository hosting, and signed AppImage update metadata, all published
  automatically from GitHub (`Tipsy-repo`, served over Pages).

## Gameplay fixes

- Mouse look overhaul: held-RMB look locks to the cursor, captured warps are
  coalesced, precise pointer-lock motion is preserved, and pointer lock
  centers and recaptures after tabbing out.
- Website Play keeps specific-server joins (PlaceLauncher job IDs retained).




## For source builds and packagers

- Binaries now target the **x86-64-v2** baseline everywhere (tests, CI, and
  all packages).
- Native `.deb` / `.rpm` builders live under `packaging/`; the Flatpak
  bundle ships after first-build validation.

name: Tipsy 1.1.0
body:
# Tipsy 1.1.0

Changes since [1.0.1](https://github.com/32bitx64bit/Tipsy/releases/tag/v1.0.1).

Official unmodified Android x86-64 Roblox only. Tipsy still does not ship, patch, or redistribute Roblox.

## Features

- **Reworked Settings and Play UI**, including System / Light / Dark appearance (stored separately from Roblox client settings).
- **Launch progress window** while Roblox starts from Play, Settings, or a website URI — it closes when the client is ready, and shows a short failure message if it does not.
- **Start fullscreen** setting: Tipsy can request an EWMH fullscreen window at map time. This is independent of Roblox’s in-app fullscreen toggle, and defaults to windowed.
- **Authenticated launch readiness.** Play and Settings only treat the client as installed after the stored generation, x86-64 `libroblox.so`, and runtime assets recheck. A source build or development AppImage still needs explicit development consent and never claims OfficialVerified.
- **Versioned system-symbol contracts** in the ELF loader. Versioned imports fail closed instead of binding a same-name symbol with an unknown ABI.

## Fixes

- **Pointer-lock look** keeps precise relative mouse motion (RMB / shift-lock).
- **Pointer grab** warps to the window center, refuses lock while unfocused, recaptures after tab-out, and leaves the desktop cursor at that center on unlock.
- **Resize storms below 1280×720** are contained. The official client can crash if the X11 window is driven under that floor.
- **Private-server share links** (`roblox-player:` / official share-code handoffs) are kept and dispatched instead of being dropped as incomplete.
- **Discord Rich Presence defaults off**, including the Join button. Existing configs that already enabled them are unchanged.
- **GameActivity native command transport** is validated before commands are written, so lifecycle commands only go out when the official glue path is actually there.

## Other

- **Official GitHub AppImages** are identified from AppRun identity plus the compiled Roblox signer floor. In-process Sigstore / TUF / `tipsy-verify` self-checks are gone; cryptographic admission stays in release CI. A replaced binary was never going to be stopped by in-process verify.
- **Setup transports** are APKPure (unofficial download, then the same official-package checks) and local files only. Unused APKMirror, Uptodown, and ADB paths were removed. Store installer APKs still fail closed.
- **Lower default X11 overhead:** committed IME text stays in a wiped side ring, and full-field overlay pixel scans run only with `TIPSY_OVERLAY_PIXEL_DIAG=1`.
- **JNI / launch diagnostic traces** are silent unless `TIPSY_DIAG=1`.
- README rewritten for current install, Play, settings, and compile-from-source flows.

## Notes

- Existing `client-settings.json` is preserved. New keys (`startFullscreen`) default off.
- Enabling Discord Rich Presence is still opt-in under Settings.
- Compare: https://github.com/32bitx64bit/Tipsy/compare/v1.0.1...main
